fns.desc: mesh_rsn_auth_init(): inside the CONFIG_PMKSA_CACHE_EXTERNAL dl_list_last() loop, if wpa_auth_pmksa_add_entry() fails (ret<0) the function returns NULL without freeing 'mesh_rsn' (os_zalloc'd at :257, already wired into bss->wpa_auth) or calling mesh_rsn_deinit() -- leaks the mesh_rsn context and its wpa_auth state on this error path.

main()'s getopt switch: case 'g' (:913), case 'G' (:917), and case 'u' (:938) all `return -1;`/`return gen_uuid();` directly instead of `goto out;`, bypassing the out: cleanup block -- leaks interfaces.dpp (dpp_global_init()'d unconditionally at :866 before the getopt loop) and any pid_file already set by an earlier -P option in the same argv, unlike sibling cases 'b'/'i' in the same switch which correctly `goto out;` on failure.
